build_profiler: build a torchdynamo profiler that wraps torch.profiler.profile and tracks captured vs total operators and microseconds
create_profilemetrics: create a ProfileMetrics dataclass with microseconds, operators, fusions, graphs and support addition and division operators
create_profileresult: create a ProfileResult combining captured and total ProfileMetrics with unique graph count and percent calculation
test_fx_insert_profiling: test the fx_insert_profiling function that wraps an fx.GraphModule with a TORCHDYNAMO record_function for profiling
summarize_should_print_missing: summarize the should_print_missing and print_missing utility functions that control stack trace printing via TORCHDYNAMO_PRINT_MISSING env var
